# How to obtain help for doxygen2docusaurus

## Quick links

The most efficient approach is to use the
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/discussions)
pages.

## Web page issues

If you encounter any issues within the content of these pages (such as typographical errors or
incorrect phrasing) or have suggestions for improving the documentation,
please share them through the
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/discussions)
pages.
Ensure you provide the full URL of the page, clearly identify the
section with the problematic content, and suggest improvements.

## Check documentation

Before asking anything, read the project
documentation.

<ProjectDocumentation/>

## Preliminary checks

Before posting any question or feedback,
verify that the subject has not already been addressed.

- Check the [FAQ](/docs/faq/)
for similar problems
- Review the [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/discussions) for
similar topics
- Examine the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/issues)
tracker and the
[GitHub Pull Requests](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/pulls)
for similar problems

## Ask questions in GitHub Discussions

If you still cannot find a solution, or if you want to share use cases,
configurations, or experiences, 
use the [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/discussions)
pages.
Initiate a **New discussion**; use the **Q&A** category for questions,
**Ideas** for suggestions, and **General** for everything else.

## Report a bug

If you have identified a bug, or want to contribute code to the
**Doxygen Documentation Converter**
project, register a **New Issue** in the
[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/issues)
tracker.

:::caution

**Do not** use the GitHub Issues tracker
for questions and support; instead, **use the
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/discussions)** pages.

:::

## Stack Overflow

For community assistance, you may also use
[Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/).
Tag your questions with `xpack`.

:::tip

Please be aware that there is another tag `elastic-x-pack` for a different
project, and some of their questions are tagged with `xpack` as well.

:::

## The Discord channel

For live discussions amongst members, join the **xPack Community** on
[Discord](https://discord.gg/EkU7Spstr).

Currently, there are several channels available:

- `#xpm`
- `#xcdl`
- `#xpack-dev-tools`
- `#general`

These channels are open for free discussions on their respective topics.

However, for support, please use GitHub Discussions whenever possible.

## X/Twitter

New releases and other announcements are posted on
[X/Twitter](https://x.com/xpack_project/).

Follow the hashtag `#xpack_project` for the latest updates.

## Use of private email

:::caution Private email

**Do not** use
private email for support; instead, **use the
[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/xpack/doxygen2docusaurus-cli-ts/discussions)** pages.

:::

Private messages will receive an automated reply containing a link
to this page. This approach is not intended to be discourteous, but
but to save time; as discussions are archived,
others facing similar issues may benefit from the provided answers.
